hero.subtitle: Discover the real Sri Lanka with your trusted local guide. Welcoming travelers from all over the world with joyful Tuk-Tuk rides, comfortable A/C Van tours, and customized island-wide adventures in English, Russian, French & German.

about.title: The Family Behind Ceylon Experience
about.p1: We are a local father-and-son guiding team born and raised right here in Kalutara, where the golden river meets the Indian Ocean. With over 25+ combined years of tourism experience across Sri Lanka, we have welcomed thousands of international travelers from the UK, Russia, France, Germany, and beyond.
about.p2: We created Ceylon Experience to treat every guest like our own family. Whether you are taking a breezy Tuk-Tuk ride through coastal villages or embarking on a multi-day island tour to Sigiriya, Kandy, Ella, and Yala in our comfortable private A/C van — we ensure your journey is safe, joyful, and unforgettable.
about.p3: To give you the most comfortable holiday without language barriers, our tours are personally guided by our family: English & Russian travelers are hosted by our founder, while French & German guests are warmly guided by my father, our senior cultural specialist.
about.feat1_desc: Personalized guidance in English, Russian, French & German with genuine local warmth.
about.feat2_desc: Defensive driving, daily cleaned vehicles, seatbelts, dual A/C, and attentive passenger care.
about.feat3_desc: From hidden beaches and local spice stalls to UNESCO ancient cities and wildlife national parks.
about.feat4_desc: Transparent local pricing with no travel agency markups, hidden fees, or pushy shopping stops.
about.guide1_desc: 10+ years local guiding. Dedicated to joyful coastal Tuk-Tuk rides, South Coast adventures, and custom private round tours.
about.guide2_desc: Over 20+ years of tourism experience. Deep historical storytelling and warm hospitality for our French and German-speaking guests.

tours.title: Tour Packages Across Sri Lanka
tours.subtitle: All itineraries can be 100% customized to your schedule, preferences, and pace.
tours.tour1_desc: Explore the world-famous hollow Kalutara Bodhiya Stupa, historic Richmond Castle, scenic Calido Beach lagoon, a peaceful Kalu Ganga river cruise, and local fruit & spice markets.
tours.tour1_h1: Kalutara Bodhiya (World's only hollow Buddhist stupa)
tours.tour1_h3: Calido Beach where the river meets the ocean
tours.tour1_h4: Authentic tropical fruit & king coconut tasting
tours.tour2_desc: Cruise through the mystical mangrove tunnels of Madu Ganga, visit Cinnamon Island, receive natural fish therapy, meet baby sea turtles at Kosgoda, and relax at Bentota Beach.
tours.tour2_h1: Boat safari through 64 mangrove islands on Madu River
tours.tour3_title: Galle Dutch Fort & Southern Coastal Wonders
tours.tour3_desc: Discover the 17th-century UNESCO Galle Fort, feed wild sea turtles in Hikkaduwa, photograph traditional Koggala stilt fishermen, and visit a Moonstone gemstone mine.
tours.tour3_h1: UNESCO World Heritage Galle Fort walking tour & lighthouse
tours.tour3_h2: Swim with and feed wild giant sea turtles at Hikkaduwa
tours.tour3_h3: Iconic stilt fishermen photography at Koggala
tours.tour3_h4: Unawatuna Japanese Peace Pagoda & jungle beach
tours.tour4_title: Mirissa Blue Whale Safari & Coconut Tree Hill
tours.tour4_desc: Embark on an early morning boat safari in the Indian Ocean to spot blue whales and dolphins, followed by lunch at Mirissa Beach and photos at Coconut Tree Hill.
tours.tour4_h1: Ethical Blue Whale & Spinner Dolphin watching boat tour
tours.tour4_h2: Famous Coconut Tree Hill panoramic viewpoint
tours.tour4_h3: Mirissa Beach seaside seafood lunch & chilling
tours.tour4_h4: Scenic coastal drive back with sunset stops
tours.tour5_desc: Experience a private 4x4 open-top jeep safari inside Udawalawe or Yala National Park. See large herds of wild Asian elephants, leopards, water buffaloes, and exotic birds.
tours.tour5_h1: Guaranteed wild elephant sightings in natural habitat
tours.tour5_h2: Private open-top 4x4 Safari Jeep with expert tracker
tours.tour6_title: Sigiriya Rock Fortress & Sacred Kandy Tour
tours.tour6_desc: Journey to Sri Lanka's cultural heart! Climb the ancient 5th-century Sigiriya Lion Rock Fortress, visit Dambulla Golden Cave Temple, and explore Kandy's Sacred Temple of the Tooth.
tours.tour6_h1: UNESCO Sigiriya Lion Rock ancient palace citadel
tours.tour6_h2: Dambulla Golden Cave Temple & giant Buddha statue
tours.tour6_h3: Kandy Sacred Temple of the Tooth & cultural dance show
tours.tour6_h4: Spice garden visit and scenic scenic highland drive
tours.tour7_title: Ella, Nuwara Eliya & Scenic Tea Country
tours.tour7_desc: Travel into the cool misty mountains! Walk across the famous Nine Arch Bridge in Ella, climb Little Adam's Peak, visit lush tea plantations & factories, and see Ravana Waterfall.
tours.tour7_h1: Iconic Nine Arch Demodara Bridge & scenic train route
tours.tour7_h2: Nuwara Eliya 'Little England' & British colonial architecture
tours.tour7_h3: Ceylon Tea factory tour & fresh tea tasting session
tours.tour7_h4: Ravana Falls & breathtaking mountain viewpoint stops
tours.tour8_desc: 24/7 reliable airport transfers with flight tracking, or full 3-to-10 day custom private round-island journeys covering beaches, wildlife, history, and mountains tailored just for you.
tours.tour8_h1: Flight monitoring for delayed or early arrivals at CMB
tours.tour8_h2: Fast expressway highway drives avoiding city traffic
tours.tour8_h3: Custom multi-day itinerary planning with hotel drop-offs
tours.tour8_h4: Spacious luggage room, chilled water & 24/7 assistance

reviews.title: What Travelers Say About Our Trips
reviews.subtitle: Real experiences from guests from around the world.
reviews.r1_text: We had an amazing time! He picked us up from Anantara Kalutara in his comfortable van and took us to Galle Fort and turtle feeding at Hikkaduwa. Speaks fluent Russian, which was super helpful for my parents. Very polite and careful driver!
reviews.r2_text: The best guide in Kalutara! We took the Tuk-Tuk local tour on our first day and liked him so much we booked his van for a 3-day round trip to Sigiriya and Ella. Seeing wild elephants and tea hills was breathtaking. Honest prices and great recommendations!
reviews.r3_text: Super service! Punctual airport transfer in the middle of the night, cold water ready in the van, and smooth driving on the highway. We also did the Madu River boat tour with him. Highly recommended to everyone visiting Sri Lanka!
reviews.r4_text: Friendly, joyful, and knowledgeable. Took us to the best authentic local curry restaurant where locals eat and showed us hidden beaches. You can trust him 100%!

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before booking your tour.
faq.q1: How do I book a tour or ride with you?
faq.a1: The easiest and fastest way is via WhatsApp! Simply click any WhatsApp button on this site or send a message with your hotel name, desired date, and which tour you'd like. I will reply immediately with availability and pricing.
faq.q2: Which languages do you speak and support?
faq.a2: I am fluent in English and Russian, and provide dedicated support for French and German travelers. We can plan your entire journey smoothly without language barriers.
faq.q3: Which areas and hotels do you pick up from?
faq.a3: I pick up from all hotels, resorts, and villas in Kalutara, Wadduwa, Maggona, Beruwala, Bentota, Ahungalla, Hikkaduwa, Galle, Colombo, and CMB Airport for island-wide tours.
faq.q4: Can we customize our tour itinerary across Sri Lanka?
faq.a4: Yes, 100%! All tours are private and flexible. Whether you want to add Sigiriya, Kandy, Ella, tea plantations, or extra beach days, we can tailor the itinerary exactly to your dreams.
faq.q5: What is the difference between Tuk-Tuk and Van tours?
faq.a5: Tuk-Tuks are perfect for 1-3 people for local scenic trips (Kalutara, Bentota, markets, beaches) with open-air views. The A/C Van is ideal for up to 9 passengers with luggage for long-distance day trips and all-island multi-day round tours.
faq.a6: You can pay in cash directly at the end of the tour in Sri Lankan Rupees (LKR), US Dollars (USD), Euros (EUR), or British Pounds (GBP). No advance deposit is needed for standard day tours.
